name: Notion

timeEstimate.approvalWait: None for internal; public distribution has extra checklist items
timeEstimate.calendarTotal: Same day for internal / your own users; longer if aiming for Notion’s public gallery

summary: Notion integrations are quick to create. The main nuance is internal vs public: internal is enough for your agent’s users via OAuth; public distribution and gallery listing add requirements. Composio manages Notion OAuth if you do not need custom branding yet.
whenYouNeedThis: Production consent should show your product name
You need capabilities or configuration beyond managed defaults
You are distributing a public Notion integration
prerequisites: Notion workspace where you can create integrations
Public website / privacy policy if making a public integration
Composio project for custom auth config

steps.title: Open Notion My Integrations
steps.detail: Go to https://www.notion.so/my-integrations and create a new integration.

steps.title: Choose internal vs public
steps.detail: Internal: workspace-scoped, fastest for testing. Public: OAuth for any Notion user — required pattern for a multi-tenant agent product.

steps.title: Configure OAuth redirect URI
steps.detail: For public integrations, add https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback as a redirect URI.

steps.title: Copy OAuth client credentials
steps.detail: Copy OAuth client ID and client secret (public integrations) into Composio custom auth config.

steps.title: Remember page sharing
steps.detail: Notion requires users to explicitly share pages/databases with the integration after connect. Plan UX copy for that step.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create Notion OAuth2 custom auth config with your credentials, then pass the config ID into connection initiation.

blockers: Using an internal-only integration when you need multi-workspace OAuth
Users connect but forget to share pages — API calls return empty/403
Public integration checklist (links, icons, privacy policy) if you pursue gallery distribution
nuances: Capability tokens / page access model is unique to Notion — OAuth alone is not enough for content access.
Composio lists NOTION under managed OAuth; BYO is for branding/control, not because managed is missing.
Notion MCP toolkit (NOTION_MCP) may be listed separately as BYO in Composio’s catalog — check the slug you actually use.
agentCanDo: Explain internal vs public integration tradeoffs
Draft redirect URI and Composio handoff steps
humanMustDo: Create the integration in Notion’s UI
Toggle public and set redirect URIs if multi-tenant
Host privacy policy if required for public distribution
nextAction: Create a public Notion integration if end users are outside your workspace, set the Composio redirect URI, then create a Composio custom auth config. If prototyping alone, use managed Notion auth first.

notes: After OAuth, remind users to share Notion pages with the integration.

evidenceNotes: Authorization model (internal vs public, share pages) confirmed from Notion developer docs.
